routine_definition:
WITH i AS (
  SELECT trim(coalesce(location_text, '')) AS t
),
p AS (
  SELECT
    t,
    CASE
      WHEN t = ''                            THEN 'Empty'
      WHEN t RLIKE '^(PIN )?[0-9]{6}( .*)?$' THEN 'PIN'
      WHEN t LIKE 'City | %'                 THEN 'City'
      WHEN t LIKE 'State | %'                THEN 'State'
      ELSE 'Free text'
    END AS kind,
    regexp_extract(t, '([0-9]{6})', 1)                           AS pin,
    nullif(regexp_extract(t, '^City \\| (.+), ([^,]+)$', 1), '') AS city_part,
    nullif(regexp_extract(t, '^City \\| (.+), ([^,]+)$', 2), '') AS city_state_part,
    nullif(regexp_extract(t, '^State \\| (.+)$', 1), '')         AS state_part
  FROM i
),
free_state AS (
  SELECT max(cs.state) AS state
  FROM workspace.carematch.canonical_states cs
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE p.kind = 'Free text' AND lower(cs.state) = lower(p.t)
),
free_city AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT lower(f.state)) AS n_states, max(f.city) AS city, max(f.state) AS state
  FROM workspace.carematch.facility_records f
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE p.kind = 'Free text'
    AND lower(f.city) = lower(p.t)
    AND lower(f.state) IN (SELECT lower(state) FROM workspace.carematch.canonical_states)
),
pin_ref AS (
  SELECT r.postcode, r.approximate_latitude, r.approximate_longitude, r.state_count, r.district_count
  FROM workspace.carematch.pincode_reference r
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE p.kind = 'PIN' AND r.postcode = p.pin
),
r AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    fs.state    AS fs_state,
    fc.n_states AS fc_n_states,
    fc.city     AS fc_city,
    fc.state    AS fc_state,
    pr.postcode AS pr_postcode,
    pr.approximate_latitude  AS pr_lat,
    pr.approximate_longitude AS pr_lon,
    pr.state_count,
    pr.district_count
  FROM p
  CROSS JOIN free_state fs
  CROSS JOIN free_city fc
  LEFT JOIN pin_ref pr ON 1 = 1
),
typed AS (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    CASE
      WHEN kind = 'Free text' AND fs_state IS NOT NULL THEN 'State'
      WHEN kind = 'Free text' AND fc_n_states = 1      THEN 'City'
      WHEN kind = 'Free text' AND fc_n_states > 1      THEN 'Ambiguous'
      WHEN kind = 'Free text'                          THEN 'Not recognized'
      WHEN kind = 'PIN' AND pr_postcode IS NULL        THEN 'Not recognized'
      ELSE kind
    END AS location_type
  FROM r
)
SELECT
  t AS input_text,
  location_type,
  CASE location_type
    WHEN 'State' THEN coalesce(state_part, fs_state)
    WHEN 'City'  THEN coalesce(city_state_part, fc_state)
  END AS filter_state,
  CASE WHEN location_type = 'City' THEN coalesce(city_part, fc_city) END AS filter_city,
  CASE WHEN location_type = 'PIN' AND pr_lat IS NULL THEN pin END AS filter_pin,
  CASE WHEN location_type = 'PIN' THEN pr_lat END AS origin_latitude,
  CASE WHEN location_type = 'PIN' THEN pr_lon END AS origin_longitude,
  CASE
    WHEN location_type = 'PIN' AND pr_lat IS NOT NULL THEN 'Approximate (PIN centroid)'
    ELSE 'None'
  END AS origin_precision,
  CASE location_type
    WHEN 'Empty'          THEN 'Choose a state, city or PIN, or enter coordinates.'
    WHEN 'Ambiguous'      THEN 'This city name exists in several states. Pick a "City | name, state" option.'
    WHEN 'Not recognized' THEN 'Location not found in the facility list or PIN directory.'
    WHEN 'State'          THEN 'Area filter only. Distance ranking unavailable.'
    WHEN 'City'           THEN 'Area filter only. Distance ranking unavailable.'
    WHEN 'PIN' THEN CASE
      WHEN pr_lat IS NULL                        THEN 'PIN has no usable coordinates. Filtering by facility postcode only.'
      WHEN district_count > 1 OR state_count > 1 THEN 'PIN maps to several districts or states. Origin is approximate.'
      ELSE 'Origin is the approximate PIN centroid, not an exact address.'
    END
  END AS location_note
FROM typed
